resources.string: Show one hand, 60–90 cm from the front camera. Try an open palm, a closed fist, or a vertical thumbs-up / thumbs-down. Hold each pose until confirmed.
Camera frames stay on this tablet. Tracking stops when you leave this screen.
Camera permission is needed for local hand tracking. Tap Start camera to allow it.
Camera permission denied. Try Start camera again, or allow Camera under App permissions if Android no longer asks.
Camera or tracking unavailable: %1$s. Check Camera access in Android Quick Settings, close other camera apps, then tap Start camera to retry.
No recent tracking frames. Check camera privacy and other camera apps, or stop and restart.
UNRECOGNISED · keep the whole hand visible
Waiting for frames. No gesture confidence score is used.
%1$.1f processed FPS · %2$.1f ms inference · %3$.1f ms pipeline\nInput: %4$d × %5$d · hands: %6$d · CPU · cap: %7$d FPS\nThrottle skips: %8$d · hold: %9$d ms · cooldown: %10$d ms · smoothing: %11$.2f
Changes restart tracking. Volume gestures are switched off while tuning. Recognition thresholds are geometric rules, not confidence scores.
Enter values within the displayed ranges.
Volume gestures off. Camera and recognition still work.
Release any held thumb, then confirm thumbs-up or thumbs-down. Keep holding to repeat if enabled.
Last action: media volume increased (held repeat).
Last action: media volume decreased (held repeat).
Minimum media volume reached. Release the thumb before another adjustment.
Maximum media volume reached. Release the thumb before another adjustment.
Android reported no change. Release the thumb and check system volume or output-device restrictions.
This output uses fixed volume. Gesture adjustments are unavailable.
Volume changes are restricted by device policy.
Android audio policy denied the adjustment. Check system sound / Do Not Disturb settings; release the thumb before retrying.
